title: Close the delivery gap in two stages
subtitle: Decision brief for the operating committee
author: Strategy Office

blocks.text: Approve four additional monthly delivery slots in two stages. Confirm staffing for the first two, then review quality and unit economics before releasing the next two.

The illustrative plan has ten committed projects and six available slots in the same month. The four-project gap is a capacity shortfall, not a revenue forecast. The model assumes comparable effort per project. If complexity differs, use effort-weighted capacity; if staffing is delayed, revisit customer start dates.

blocks.caption: Capacity expansion should follow two operating gates

rows: Confirm staffed capacity and project mix
Review cycle time, quality, and unit economics
Reconcile signed commitments and start dates
